latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Trimmer Online — AI-powered video trimming:

- Upload, trim, and export video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) with natural language instructions.
- Automatic backend connection and token management; up to 100 free credits for new users.
- Fast, server-side rendering of edits, typically within 20–40 seconds for short clips.
- Supports status, credits, and session state queries.
- No editing software required; ideal for quick, installation-free video processing.
